== Description ==
Worlds 2026 deck box from the [[2026 World Championship]].

== Source and credit ==
Retained JPEG preview of [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fYv4VA1KlCsUgCQSz98JSG9GlFrNGxOs/view IMG_1581.HEIC], in the shared Worlds 2026 Photos & Videos album.

== Changes ==
Full frame retained. The available source is a JPEG preview of the HEIC photograph. Encoded orientation normalized and JPEG display rendition prepared with FFmpeg; longest edge limited to 2,400 pixels without upscaling.
